evals.prompt: Deliver a team-invite feature to the kit — multi-tenant, email invites with role selection.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/DeliverFeature.md: preflight capability probe, auto-classified scope recorded in the PRD, G1 spawn of PM/SM/UX/UI/Architect.

evals.prompt: Review open PRs in the kit and give me team verdicts for each.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/ReviewOpenPRs.md: PR sweep with kit-native roster reviewers, per-PR verdict + TODO artifact; empty PR set reports-and-exits before any spawn.

evals.prompt: Deep review pr #87 in kit — I want the full 13-agent take before we merge.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/ReviewSinglePR.md: checks out the PR head, fans out reviewers per the L2 ladder, aggregates a typed verdict, posts one edit-last PR comment plus the TODO artifact JSON.

evals.prompt: execute todos for pr #42
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/ExecuteOpenTodos.md: cuts a fresh fix/pr-42-todos side branch, executes TODO batches serially with per-batch verify, stops at the merge boundary.

evals.prompt: Refresh the kit docs — the billing section still describes the old checkout flow.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/DocsRefresh.md: Phase 0 runs BuildDigest then VerifyDigest (exit 0/1/2, VACUOUS stops), then the Writer refreshes the scoped docs.

evals.prompt: quick fix in the kit: theres a typo in the pricing page metadata title, 2 sec job
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/QuickFix.md: surgical <=2-file fix by the owning agent, QA validation, no full-team convening.

evals.prompt: Run a security audit for the kit's auth surface — sessions, MFA, passkeys.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/SecurityAudit.md: Security Engineer audit with the DB Engineer always running in parallel (Phase 1b memo), threat model + remediation list, no code writes.

evals.prompt: Feature archaeology in the kit: how does personal-account billing actually work end to end?
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/ExploreFeature.md: read-only parallel archaeology (architect/frontend/backend/database) mapping the feature surface.

evals.prompt: Run the makerkit delivery pipeline for a notifications center in the saas kit.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers and routes to Workflows/DeliverFeature.md via the 'run delivery pipeline' / 'build feature in saas kit' triggers.

evals.prompt: can u ship a dark mode toggle featur to the kit, users keep askin
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam triggers despite the typos ('ship feature to kit') and routes to Workflows/DeliverFeature.md.

evals.prompt: Deliver a rate-limiting feature in the starter — the FastAPI one.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; FastAPIStarterTeam owns dos-fastapi-starter delivery motions.

evals.prompt: fastapi starter pipeline: add JWT refresh tokens and ship it
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; routes to FastAPIStarterTeam.

evals.prompt: Review my nextjs app, it's a side project I built last weekend.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; a generic Next.js app outside the kit routes to /code-review or FeatureDelivery, not the kit roster.

evals.prompt: Comment on PR #12 in durante-tech/dotfiles and merge it if CI is green.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; generic GitHub PR operations on a non-kit repo route to the github skill.

evals.prompt: Build a cinematic landing page for my personal portfolio site.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; landing-page work routes to CinematicLanding / frontend-design, not the kit delivery team.

evals.prompt: theres a bug in my python scraper, it dies on pagination, can you fix it
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; a non-kit Python repo is generic bug-fix work (FeatureDelivery fallback or direct fix).

evals.prompt: Scaffold a brand new FastAPI project with auth and Postgres.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; new FastAPI scaffolding routes to FastAPIStarterTeam or generic scaffolding, not the Makerkit roster.

evals.prompt: Code review this standalone express server before I deploy it to my VPS.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; non-kit repos use /code-review or FeatureDelivery — the kit-qualified 'code review for kit' trigger does not match.

evals.prompt: Make me a design system for my react app — tokens, components, the works.
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; design-system creation routes to DesignSystem/Brand skills.

evals.prompt: I'm building a saas, what stack should I pick for auth and billing?
evals.expected_output: MakerkitTeam does NOT trigger; an advisory stack question with no kit repo in play is a plain answer, not a kit delivery motion.
